description_en: Updates the consumer on which a gateway performs authentication operations
name: UpdateGatewayAuthConsumer

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the gateway
parameters.name: gateway_unique_id

parameters.help_en:
The encryption type. Valid values:

RSA
OCT
parameters.name: encode_type

parameters.help_en: The JWT public key. The JSON format is supported
parameters.name: jwks

parameters.help_en: The names of the parameters that are required to verify each token. By default, each token is prefixed with Bearer and stored in the Authorization header, such as `Authorization: Bearer <Content of a token>`
parameters.help_zh: 要校验的Token参数信息的名称，默认是以Bearer为前缀放在Authorization header中，例如：`Authorization: Bearer token`
parameters.name: token_name

parameters.help_en: The positions of the parameters that are required to verify each token. By default, each token is prefixed with Bearer and stored in the Authorization header, such as `Authorization: Bearer <Content of a token>`
parameters.help_zh: 要校验的Token参数信息的位置，默认是以Bearer为前缀放在Authorization header中，例如：`Authorization: Bearer token`
parameters.name: token_position

parameters.help_en: The prefixes of the parameters that are required to verify each token. By default, each token is prefixed with Bearer and stored in the Authorization header, such as `Authorization: Bearer <Content of a token>`
parameters.help_zh: 要校验的Token参数信息的前缀，默认是以Bearer为前缀放在Authorization header中，例如：`Authorization: Bearer token`
parameters.name: token_prefix

parameters.help_en: The name of the key used for JWT-based identity authentication
parameters.name: key_name

parameters.help_en: The value of the key used for JWT-based identity authentication
parameters.name: key_value

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
返回信息的语言类型：

zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: accept_language

Code.description_en: The status code. A value of 200 is returned if the request is successful

DynamicCode.description_en: The dynamic part in the error message
DynamicCode.description_zh: 动态错误信息中的占位符
DynamicCode.title_en: 动态错误信息中的占位符
DynamicCode.title_zh: 动态错误信息中的占位符

DynamicMessage.description_en:
The dynamic part in the error message. This parameter is used to replace the \%s\ variable in the ErrMessage parameter.

If the return value of the ErrMessage parameter is The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid and the return value of the DynamicMessage parameter is DtsJobId, the specified DtsJobId parameter is invalid
DynamicMessage.description_zh:
动态错误信息，用于替换返回参数ErrMessage错误信息中的%s。
如果ErrMessage返回The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid，且DynamicMessage返回DtsJobId，则代表所传入的请求参数DtsJobId不合法

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code that is returned

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

`true`: The request was successful.
`false`: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求结果，取值如下：
`true`：请求成功。
`false`：请求失败
